EMBJ.why: An Industrials leader closing at a new 52-week high on more than twice its normal volume, with its daily and hourly trends rising.
EMBJ.contested: Contested: part of the room would buy a pause at the broken level rather than strength at the high; it clears on a pullback that holds the 20-day average, or an hourly close above yesterday's high on heavy volume.

HUM.why: A Healthcare leader coiled 4.0% under its pivot with the weekly trend rising and relative strength in the top tenth.
HUM.contested: Contested: the daily trend is still lower highs and lower lows, so part of the room wants a pullback hook; it clears when the daily resolves to higher highs or the pivot breaks on heavy volume.

CAH.why: A Healthcare leader closing at a 52-week closing high with its averages in order, but on thin volume.
CAH.contested: Contested: the break came on 0.85 times normal volume with the weekly still lower highs and lows, and the backers share no single trigger; it clears when volume reaches normal on the break bar.

TGTX.why: A Healthcare leader that broke out on 3.1 times normal volume, then faded to close in the lower part of its hourly range.
TGTX.contested: No objection filed: the room agreed.

GPN.why: A held Financials leader just over its swing high after a 24.76% ten-day run, kept but not added to.
GPN.contested: Contested: one view is that adding after a run this far buys the extreme, and it clears only after a first pullback holds the 20-day average and hooks back up.

LTH.why: A Consumer Discretionary leader on a reclaim day, closing near its high on more than twice normal volume.
LTH.contested: Contested: the buy line sits under the prior high while the hourly trend is still down, so one view wants the break of the 48.61 swing high; it clears when the hourly averages are back in order.

KO.why: A Staples leader through its pivot to a new 52-week high on thin volume.
KO.contested: Dropped: the pullback entry buys a dip the price action says is already over; it returns with a close above the 97.39 swing high on rising volume.

TMO.why: A Healthcare name at a new high that advanced yesterday, rated in-line rather than a leader, on 0.74 times normal volume.
TMO.contested: Dropped: the breakout trigger carries no volume test and the trend's force is interrupted; it returns on a break above 1.4 times normal volume with a leader rating.

MAC.why: A Real Estate leader sitting at its highs rather than pulling back, with relative strength just under the 70 floor.
MAC.contested: Dropped: the pullback entry does not fit a name at its highs and its 50-day sits under its 100-day; it returns when that order is repaired and a break prints on heavy volume.

PRCH.why: A Technology leader at a new high on heavy volume, but far above its own averages.
PRCH.contested: Dropped: it sits far over its 200-day average, which reads as a climax to sell into; it returns after a controlled pullback holds and hooks back up.
